scope: Local supported geometric edit checks, real Argon render/review/correction evidence, preserved source geometry, targeted retry fixes and accurate reference metadata. No deployment.

integrations.purpose: Interpret original edit requirements, inspect actual rendered geometry, propose scoped corrections and check another render, with application-measured checks and saved evidence.
integrations.implementation_ref: lib/studio/quality-client.ts, quality-engine.ts, design-constraints.ts, constraint-planner.ts; app/api/device/route.ts; followup-source-manifest.json and reference-release-source-check.json document the verified source.

checks.expected: Final regression suite, TypeScript and production build pass.
checks.observed: 320 tests passed; 6 opt-in suites skipped by default and saved-evidence suites run separately. TypeScript and production build passed.

checks.expected: Run the complete fixed 24-trial protocol without substitutions and retain every result.
checks.observed: 24/24 completed; 15/16 seeded repairs, 2/4 fresh edits and 3/4 negative controls passed. Four failures remain recorded; 35 actual reviews and 105 verified image hashes. This check concerns protocol integrity, not perfect reliability.

checks.expected: Historical full matrix: all 20 positive trials and all 4 negative controls succeed.
checks.observed: 17/20 positive trials and 3/4 negative controls passed before the scoped follow-up fixes. Failures: fresh-edit timeout, invalid edit output, planning timeout, provider error. The final full matrix was not rerun.

checks.expected: The targeted post-fix retest completes both repeats of all four affected tasks with correct outcomes.
checks.observed: 8/8 passed: 4/4 fresh edits, 2/2 seeded separation repairs, 2/2 negative controls. 10 actual reviews and 30 images. This small targeted result is separate from the older full matrix.

checks.expected: Offline recomputation reproduces recorded geometry, task outcomes, contracts, document fingerprints and image associations.
checks.observed: All five saved-artifact checks passed without provider calls, including the normal workspace export and accepted source study.

checks.expected: Normal workspace accepts a measured source-CAD correction while preserving unrelated parts, with exact undo, redo and save restoration.
checks.observed: After a recorded provider-timeout retry, the 70-part Corne study was automatically accepted in 66.9 seconds. 6/6 requested checks passed; 69 original parts and source radio geometry unchanged. Enclosure margin 2.0 mm, PCB gap 2.1 mm, insert gap 0.4 mm; required 0.2 mm. Undo/redo and reload verified.

checks.expected: Fix the reference metadata inconsistency without weakening measurement or changing actual geometry or source dimensions.
checks.observed: 42 authored procedural parts have corrected envelope size metadata. Meshes, poses, rendered shapes and source dimensions are unchanged; original nominal values retained in specs.

checks.expected: Real maker study measures usefulness and understanding against a normal workflow.
checks.observed: Prepared protocol only. No participants, human ratings, time savings, outreach or results invented.

checks.expected: Physical hardware validates fastening, tolerances, electronics, firmware and operation.
checks.observed: No physical hardware validation was performed; geometric and image results do not establish those claims.
